req.title: Support all HTTP verbs on /status/<code>
req.statement: The system shall accept GET, POST, PUT, PATCH, DELETE, HEAD, OPTIONS, and TRACE on /status/<code>.

doc.reasoning: The requirement states that /status/<code> must accept GET, POST, PUT, PATCH, DELETE, HEAD, OPTIONS, and TRACE. The source shows the route is registered for GET, POST, PUT, DELETE, PATCH, TRACE but NOT HEAD or OPTIONS explicitly (Flask handles HEAD automatically for GET routes; OPTIONS may be auto-handled). Tests must cover: (1) positive EP for each supported verb returning the exact requested status code, (2) boundary BVA around status code numeric thresholds (199/200/201, 299/300/301), (3) negative NEG for invalid/non-numeric codes returning 400, (4) DT for multiple verbs on the same code, and (5) BVA for edge status codes like 100, 599. Mutation resilience requires exact status code assertions, both sides of comparisons, and exact response status values.

trace: R-HTTPBIN-017: 406 is special-cased with JSON body and Content-Type header
tests.executable:
import json
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()

def test_get_406_returns_406_with_json_body():
    r = client.get('/status/406')
    assert r.status_code == 406
    assert r.content_type == 'application/json'
    body = json.loads(r.data.decode('utf-8'))
    assert 'message' in body
    assert body['message'] == 'Client did not request a supported media type.'

tests.name: test_state_transition_get_then_post_same_code
actions: Then send POST /status/200 on same client
trace: R-HTTPBIN-017: STC verifying stateless behavior across sequential requests with different verbs
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()

def test_state_transition_get_then_post_same_code():
    r1 = client.get('/status/200')
    assert r1.status_code == 200
    r2 = client.post('/status/200')
    assert r2.status_code == 200
    r3 = client.get('/status/404')
    assert r3.status_code == 404
    r4 = client.post('/status/201')
    assert r4.status_code == 201
